title: My First Period
description: Navigating your very first menstruation experience with comfort, facts, and gentle confidence.

scenes.dialogue: Something feels different today... I noticed a small reddish-brown spot on my underwear and my belly feels a bit tight. What should I do?

choices.text: Talk to someone I trust (Mom, older sister, guardian or school nurse)
choices.educationalNote: Talking openly with a trusted adult helps you get pads, comfort, and warm support right away!

choices.text: Check a safe learning guide or Bloom AI
choices.educationalNote: Getting accurate health facts removes fear and lets you know your body is growing completely normally!
It is totally natural to feel shy at first, but remember: menstruation happens to every girl and is a milestone of healthy growth!

scenes.dialogue: You reach out to someone you trust. They smile warmly, give you a comforting hug, and hand you your first soft menstrual pad!

choices.text: Ask how to wear a pad step-by-step
choices.educationalNote: Unfold the pad, remove the sticky strip backing, and stick it snugly onto your underwear.

scenes.dialogue: You open BloomTale! You discover that a period is simply your body's natural cycle preparing for growing up.

choices.text: Learn how to prepare a small hygiene pouch
choices.educationalNote: Keeping 2 pads and spare underwear in your bag keeps you stress-free wherever you go.

scenes.dialogue: Your companion avatar reminds you: 'You are safe, strong, and surrounded by care. Millions of girls experience this every month!'

choices.text: Take a deep breath and prepare a pad
choices.educationalNote: Deep breathing calms emotional waves and boosts your confidence.

scenes.dialogue: Awesome! You now know how to wear a pad, change it every 4-6 hours, wrap used ones neatly in paper, and wash your hands. How do you feel now?

choices.text: I feel confident, prepared, and proud of my body!
choices.educationalNote: Congratulations on completing your first story module!

scenes.dialogue: You packed your cute hygiene kit into your school bag! You feel empowered and ready to handle any day.

choices.educationalNote: You earned the 'Period Pro' milestone progress!
